s.en: set and clear NFS and RPC kernel debug flags

syn: rpcdebug -vh ⏎ rpcdebug -m module ⏎ rpcdebug -m module -s flags... ⏎ rpcdebug -m module -c flags...

o.en: Print a help message and exit. When combined with the -v option, also prints the available debug flags.

Specify which module's flags to set or clear. Available modules are: nfsd The NFS server. nfs The NFS client. nlm The Network Lock Manager, in either an NFS client or server. rpc The Remote Procedure Call module, in either an NFS client or server.
Increase the verbosity of rpcdebug's output.
